title: Diff view
goal: Show file changes as a readable, collapsible unified diff in the terminal, with word-level highlights, line numbers and safe handling of hostile or huge input.
scope_in: Unified-diff parser (`parseUnifiedDiff(text)`) and a two-string differ (`diffStrings(old, new, {context: 3})`) producing `DiffFile[]` with hunks and line records (`add|del|ctx`, old/new line numbers).

`<DiffView files expanded onToggle width />` rendering per DESIGN §10.1.3: added lines `status.success` on `status.success.subtle` prefixed `+`, removed `status.danger` on `status.danger.subtle` prefixed `-`, context `text.secondary` with 3 lines either side, line numbers `text.muted` right-aligned in 5 columns.
Word-level highlights for paired changed lines (tokenise on word/punctuation boundaries, LCS diff): changed spans rendered bold on a brighter background; skip pairing for lines over 2,000 chars.

Collapse of long unchanged gaps to a row `⋯ 42 unchanged lines` (gap > 6 lines), expandable with `⏎` when focused; file header row `path  +12 −3`; binary files show `Binary file changed`; renamed files `old → new`.
Caps: 2,000 rendered lines per file and 200 files per view with `⋯ N more lines` / `⋯ N more files` rows.
Adapter from the `diff.share` secret payload (`files`, optional `blob`) and from local edit tool results to `DiffFile[]`.
scope_out: Computing git diffs from the repository (runner/worktree lanes supply patch text).
Interactive hunk staging, apply or revert actions, and side-by-side layout (not in v1).
Fetching a `blb_` blob referenced by `diff.share` (net lanes); this lane receives text.
build_against: Pure component tests with prop fixtures and the pty/TUI snapshot tester from lane C008 (ink-testing-library plus pty harness, frames captured at 80x24 and 120x40). No backend is needed; any session data comes from contracts/fixtures/events/*.json or hand-built typed values from @centcom/protocol (lane C003). Diff inputs are golden unified diffs from `git diff` runs checked in under packages/tui/test/fixtures/diffs/ plus the `diff.share` fixture in contracts/fixtures/events/.
interfaces: `parseUnifiedDiff(text: string, limits?: {maxFiles?: number; maxLinesPerFile?: number}): DiffFile[]`
`diffStrings(oldText: string, newText: string, opts?: {context?: number}): DiffFile`

`type DiffFile = {oldPath?: string; newPath: string; status: 'added'|'deleted'|'modified'|'renamed'|'binary'; hunks: Hunk[]; adds: number; dels: number}`; `type DiffLine = {kind: 'add'|'del'|'ctx'; oldNo?: number; newNo?: number; text: string}`
`<DiffView files: DiffFile[]; width: number; maxRows?: number; focusable?: boolean />`
`fromDiffShare(files: unknown[]): DiffFile[]` (tolerates unknown shapes, returns what it can)
acceptance: A 3-file golden diff renders at 80 columns with `+`/`-` prefixes, 5-column right-aligned line numbers, and no line longer than 80 columns (long lines wrap with a continuation indent of 7 columns).
Under `NO_COLOR` added/removed lines are distinguishable by the `+`/`-` prefix and word-level changes by reverse video; no colour SGR codes are emitted.
A hunk with 60 unchanged lines between changes shows `⋯ 54 unchanged lines` (3 context lines each side kept) and `⏎` on the focused row expands it in place.
Word-level highlight: changing `retryCount` to `retryLimit` on one line highlights only the differing span `Count`/`Limit` (assert on style ranges).
A 50,000-line diff parses in under 300 ms and renders 2,000 lines + `⋯ 48,000 more lines`; memory stays under 50 MiB (benchmark guard).
Binary patch (`Binary files a/x and b/x differ`) renders `Binary file changed`; a pure rename with 100 % similarity renders `old → new` with no hunks.
Terminal escape bytes inside diff content (`\x1b[2J`, `\x1b]0;title\x07`) never reach stdout raw; they appear as visible `␛` placeholders.
CRLF files and files without trailing newline render the marker `\ No newline at end of file` as a muted row.
tests: diff/parse.test.ts: golden diffs, renames, binary, no-newline, CRLF; fuzz test that arbitrary text never throws.
diff/words.test.ts: LCS word diff cases and the 2,000-char cutoff.
diff/diff-share.test.ts: `fromDiffShare` with the contract fixture and with unknown shapes.
guardrails: MUST replace control characters and escape sequences in diff text with visible placeholders before rendering; diff content comes from untrusted repos and remote members.
MUST NOT execute, apply or write anything; the component is display-only.
MUST bound work: parsing and word-diffing are capped by the limits above so a hostile diff cannot hang the UI (word diff aborts after 5 ms per line pair).
MUST NOT rely on colour alone: `+`/`-` prefixes are always present.
MUST show paths as given but sanitised; do not resolve or open them.
failure_modes: Malformed diff text -> show the raw text in a muted block with the header `※ Couldn't parse this diff.` instead of throwing.
`diff.share` file entries of unknown shape -> skip those entries, show `⋯ N files couldn't be shown`.
Width below 40 -> render file headers and counts only, with `⋯ widen the terminal to see changes`.
